messages:
sasha: Heads-up — I applied the gpupool module split PR (gpupool-core + gpupool-network) to staging via GitOps.
infra-bot: sync: applied manifest modules/gpupool-network v1.0.0 -> reconcile started :gear:
felix: seeing reconcile failing in eu-west-2 with quota errors and an IAM boundary deny on KMS key usage.
priya: can you paste the controller logs? quick glance suggests provider alias mismatch between old module and new split.
ben_m: logs: `ERROR: AttachVolume: quotaExceeded` then `AccessDenied: PutKeyPolicy on arn:aws:kms:eu-west-2:... denied by policy boundary`.
danielle: That KMS boundary was tightened last month for prod-only keys. Staging should be allowed but maybe the new module creates a key with a different principal.
sasha: here's the relevant snippet I added to modules/gpupool-network/iam.tf:
```
resource "aws_kms_key" "gpupool" {
  description = "GPUpool node key - staging"
  policy      = data.aws_iam_policy_document.kms_policy.json
}
```
felix: The old module relied on a central kms alias and IAM role with boundary `service-role/gpu-*`. The split creates a new key, so the role never got permission.
priya: Also the provider block in gpupool-core still uses the legacy provider alias `provider "aws" { alias = "legacy" }` while gpupool-network uses default provider. That causes two different callers to try to manage overlapping resources.
ben_m: Could explain the transient quota error: creating keys in eu-west-2 hit account KMS quota when both modules attempted creation concurrently during reconciliation.
devops-bot: autoscaler event: "node provisioning stalled" -> drain pending for 6m :warning:
sasha: Proposed immediate mitigation: revert gpupool-network key creation and point the module to use shared KMS alias (temporary). Then re-run GitOps apply sequentially with a canary region (us-west-2 first).
danielle: Agreed. Also add a tf pre-commit check to detect provider alias collisions and a GitOps hook to enforce sequential module applies per-region.
priya: I'll open a small PR to change kms_key -> data.aws_kms_key.lookup with alias lookup, and add a provider = aws.legacy where needed.
felix: For the quota, add a retry/backoff in the controller for KMS CreateKey 429 -> this is causing the reconcile to flip-flop and spam the queue.
ben_m: Cost note: if we fallback to creating new keys across regions it will add ~0.40 USD/month per key plus cross-region replication bandwidth during testing — small but we should avoid mass-creation.
sasha: action items: 1) priya to open PR to switch to shared KMS alias (eta 30m). 2) danielle to add GitOps gate for sequential region rollout. 3) felix to patch controller retry. 4) ben_m to monitor autoscaler and abort any spike.
priya: PR opened: https://git.redwood/gp/infra/pulls/482 — includes tf change and a tf-plan that shows zero resources to create in eu-west-2 after alias lookup.
infra-bot: CI plan: modules/gpupool-network plan -> 0 to create, 1 to change (iam role binding) :white_check_mark:
ben_m: I'll hold the canary apply in us-west-2 for 15m then promote if green. :eyes:
sasha: thanks everyone. i'll rollback the GitOps apply in eu-west-2 now and then coordinate the canary with ben_m. ping me if autoscaler still stalls.
felix: leaving a note in runbook: Runbook > infra/gpupool/provider-split.md with checklist for provider alias, kms alias, sequential apply.
sasha: :thumbsup:
